title: Get Presale Tickets to Metallica’s M72 World Tour 2027
summary: Metallica’s spring 2027 stadium tour features special guests Limp Bizkit and Avatar.
body_markdown:
[Metallica](https://www.siriusxm.com/blog/tag/metallica) has announced the spring 2027 leg of their M72 World Tour, featuring Limp Bizkit and Avatar — and SiriusXM listeners can access tickets in a special presale before they go on sale to the general public.


[Maximum Metallica Hits, rare tracks & live concerts Listen on the App Listen on the App](https://sxm.app.link/BlogMetallicaM72Presale)


Metallica’s M72 World Tour returns to stadiums in spring 2027 with the band’s signature in-the-round stage positioned at the 50-yard line. See how to access the SiriusXM presale below.


### **Metallica M72 World Tour 2027**


#### **How to Get Presale Tickets**


SiriusXM listeners can access presale tickets on Thursday, September 24, from 10am to 10pm local time[here](https://metallica.lnk.to/M72WorldTour2027) using code **SIRIUSXM.**


Don’t miss your chance to access tickets before they go on sale to the general public.


### **Metallica M72 World Tour 2027 Dates**


Metallica’s spring 2027 stadium tour features special guests Limp Bizkit and Avatar. See the announced tour dates, cities and venues below.


**Saturday, May 8** Vancouver, BC BC Place


**Thursday, May 13** San Diego, CA Snapdragon Stadium


**Tuesday, May 18** El Paso, TX Sun Bowl


**Saturday, May 22** San Antonio, TX Alamo Dome


**Wednesday, May 26** Fayetteville, AR Razorback Stadium


**Saturday, May 29** Kansas City, MO Arrowhead Stadium


**Wednesday, June 2** Raleigh, NC Carter-Finley Stadium


**Saturday, June 5** Indianapolis, IN Lucas Oil Stadium


**Tuesday, June 8** Buffalo, NY New Highmark Stadium


**Saturday, June 12** Madison, WI Camp Randall Stadium


**Tuesday, June 15** Cleveland, OH Huntington Bank Stadium


**Saturday, June 19** Salt Lake City, UT Rice-Eccles Stadium


#### **Listen to Maximum Metallica on SiriusXM**


Before Metallica hits the road, hear the band’s music, live performances, rarities, and more on SiriusXM’s Maximum Metallica (Ch. 42) on car radios and the[SiriusXM app](https://sxm.app.link/BlogMetallicaM72Presale) .
